$comment: Each repository's check command (sync-quality.mjs --command), by its directory name, where it is not the default `cargo xtask ci`. sync-quality.mjs takes it from here when --command is not given and refuses a --command that disagrees, so a sync never puts back an old command: change it here. The kits only run the fmt check here: their full checks and tests run on GitHub (Kition's kit CI, docs/kits.md section 4c).

commands.kition-sdk: pnpm -s typecheck && pnpm -s test && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
